cases.name: discard-client-state
cases.purpose: Expose both endpoints but restart decoding for each chunk, losing cross-call state.

cases.name: plain-text-only
cases.purpose: Keep native decoding but bypass non-streaming reasoning and tool parsing.

cases.name: discard-logprobs
cases.purpose: Return empty logprob entries while ordinary response text remains valid.

cases.name: ignore-prompt-usage
cases.purpose: Drop caller-supplied prompt accounting in non-streaming chat responses.

cases.name: alternative-native-decoder-replay
cases.purpose: Use full token history and native decoder replay instead of the Oracle's retained decode window.

cases.name: omit-terminal-flush
cases.purpose: Leave buffered terminal text unflushed, reproducing the reviewed Oracle failure.

cases.name: reject-long-returned-state
cases.purpose: Reject the decoder's own valid returned state after a long deferred-text chunk.

cases.name: reject-null-stream-delta
cases.purpose: Reject explicit null deltas while accepting omitted and empty token arrays.

cases.name: python-forwarding
cases.purpose: Delegate the Base Rust render entry point to the installed Python implementation; the native runtime must reject it.
